Chapter 885: Chapter 21 Myriad Transformation Queen (Please Subscribe)_2

But unfortunately,

they misjudged the depth and height of Lin Yuan’s life essence.

Actually, it’s not quite a misjudgment, even those at Level Twelve wouldn’t expect a Level Eleven to possess such profound life essence.

The mightiest of the Human Civilization Alliance were confident because they knew of the commotion caused by Lin Yuan’s breakthrough to Level Ten and then to Level Eleven.

But the other Level Twelve Ultimates didn’t know that.

Even the mightiest of Human Civilization probably wouldn’t have imagined Lin Yuan’s life essence would reach such depth.

It’s almost as if he had created a new realm between Level Eleven and Twelve.

“Almost everyone has arrived.”

Lin Yuan’s thought stirred slightly, activating Divine Ability ‘World’ without a sound.

…

“Kill.”

“Galaxy Master, we’ve come to kill you.”

…

Numerous strongest Level Eleven beings approached in an instant, intending to activate their Clan Suppression Weapons and blast the altar.

Just at this moment—

From all directions, above and below, left and right.

Heaven and earth changed, as a brand-new world seemed to descend.

“Hm?”

“What’s this?”

“Galaxy Master, the Galaxy Master has used that ultimate reserve again.”

…

The strongest Level Elevens turned pale, somewhat in disbelief.

Even the strongest Level Eleven of the Robber Clan felt a sudden pang of anxiety in his heart.

Didn’t Fan Gaomo say that he’d use the Yu Clan’s treasured scales to greatly diminish the Galaxy Master’s life essence, rendering him unable to use that ultimate reserve anymore?

What’s happening now?

In the blink of an eye, over ten strongest Level Elevens, without hesitation, turned and fled.

Ten years ago, they had witnessed the power of the Galaxy Master with their own eyes, back when tens of thousands of Level Elevens were present, invisibly sharing the might of Divine Ability ‘World’ with them.

But now?

Only they, the strongest Level Elevens, were present.

How could they dare to stay any longer?

…

At the outskirts.

Fan Gaomo was also closely watching the battlefield.

Before him, the golden scales, with the essence of nothingness on both sides providing balance, indicated that the life essence of the Galaxy Master was still being weakened.

“If not for that ultimate reserve, the Galaxy Master wouldn’t be much stronger than other strongest Level Elevens, now facing…”

Fan Gaomo’s thoughts fluctuated, but soon after, he received inquiries from the strongest Level Elevens of races such as the Insect Race and the Tianyu Clan.

“Fan Gaomo, the life essence of the Galaxy Master has not weakened at all.”

“Fan Gaomo, the Galaxy Master still activated that ultimate reserve, and now we’re all being suppressed.”

“Fan Gaomo, did you deceive us? Have you sided with the Human Civilization Alliance?”

…

Question after question left Fan Gaomo somewhat bewildered.

He glanced at the golden scales before him, where the essence of nothingness, representing the life essence of the Galaxy Master, was properly placed on the right side.

Balanced against a tenth of the life essence of a hundred Level Eleven Perfect beings on the left side.

He almost thought he had heard wrong.

“Impossible.”

Fan Gaomo immediately realized, feeling the vast presence emanating from the center of the battlefield.

This presence was something Fan Gaomo would never forget for all eternity.

It was the very move the Galaxy Master used ten years ago to annihilate tens of thousands of Level Eleven powerhouses, and compared to ten years before, the might of this move had not weakened in the slightest.

But how could this be?

He had already weakened the Galaxy Master’s life essence using the balance scales, even if the weakened Galaxy Master could still use that ultimate reserve.

But the reduction in life essence should have inevitably led to a weakened effect of this ultimate reserve.

Yet now, the vast presence Fan Gaomo felt from the center of the battlefield did not seem to have weakened at all.

Could it be that he didn’t weaken the Galaxy Master?

No, that’s not right.

The Balance Scale is weakening the Galaxy Master.

Fan Gaomo could still sense the connection with the Galaxy Master through the Balance Scale.

“What on earth is going on?”

“Could there be a problem with the Balance Scale?”

The real body of Fan Gaomo, in the outside world, immediately began to contact the ‘King’ of the Yu Clan.

…

Yu Clan Territory.

Inside the palace.

Fan Gaomo stood below, waiting cautiously for the ‘King’ seated on the high throne to respond.

The Balance Scale had already weakened the life essence of the Galaxy Master, and even the corresponding breath of nothingness formed by this life essence had appeared on the right side of the scale.

Why did the Galaxy Master seem unaffected?

“The Balance Scale has indeed weakened the life essence of the Galaxy Master.”

A breath later, the ‘King’ of the Yu Clan slowly stated.

Although Fan Gaomo was operating the Balance Scale, a treasure of the Yu Clan,

In fact, the ‘King’ of the Yu Clan was also closely monitoring it, and inside the Balance Scale there was a contingency plan left by the ‘King’.

“Indeed weakened the Galaxy Master?”

Fan Gaomo grew even more perplexed.

But the current behavior of the Galaxy Master? Isn’t that completely inconsistent with having weakened life essence and a subsequent sharp decline in strength?

“It could be… The life essence you weakened is too little for the Galaxy Master, hence his strength wasn’t significantly affected.”

Another breath later, the ‘King’ of the Yu Clan gave a reply.

“Too little?”

Fan Gaomo was somewhat stunned.

A fraction of the life essence of a hundred Level Eleven Perfect beings, equivalent to the full life essence of ten Level Eleven Perfect entities, even accounting for losses, would still be the full life essence of four or five Level Eleven Perfect beings.

So this substantial amount of life essence is too little for the Galaxy Master?

…

In a huge battlefield,

Lin Yuan looked at the more than ten strongest Level Eleven entities, struggling with difficulty under the envelopment of the Divine Ability ‘World’ and assisted by their Clan Suppression Weapons.

Compared to ten years ago, Lin Yuan had greatly improved his strength, with a dozen insights into fusion rules reaching the twelfth-layer level, causing another transformation in the world within his body.

With the internal world enhanced, the external world created by the Divine Ability ‘World’ was naturally augmented.

Ten years ago, the strongest Level Eleven entities from the various peak clans could tear through the space of the external world with their Clan Suppression Weapons and flee far away.

But a decade later, they could no longer do so.

Even though the Clan Suppression Weapons kept bursting with terrifying fluctuations, it was in vain. Within the realm covered by the external world, space was as solid as a substance; no one but Lin Yuan could rip it open.

“Although enough to trap these strongest Level Eleventh entities, even if the external world exploded of its own accord, it’s estimated that it would be very hard to kill a single strongest Level Eleven.”

Lin Yuan looked down at the strongest Level Eleven entities, barely struggling under the overwhelming power of the magnificent world, and thought to himself.

The biggest difference between a Clan Suppression Weapon and the ultimate weapons is not the level of their might; in fact, the pinnacle might of some ultimate weapons is not much inferior to the Clan Suppression Weapons.

The main difference lies in who is wielding it.

The wielders of the ultimate weapons are the Level Eleven entities themselves, so unless absolutely necessary, they would not use the ultimate weapons due to the excessive consumption.

When Lin Yuan first arrived in the battlefield, he made a few moves that, while hiding his true strength, killed the Level Eleven entities wielding ultimate weapons by exhausting them to death.

But Clan Suppression Weapons?

The real manipulators are actually not the strongest Level Eleven entities of the various clans but the ultimate beings of the twelfth level behind them.

Inside every Clan Suppression Weapon resides methods left by these ultimate beings of the twelfth level, lurking normally, but at a critical moment, they will erupt.

Directly taking over the Clan Suppression Weapons.

The strong Level Eleven entities holding the Clan Suppression Weapons were unable to tear through the space of the external world, not because the might of the ultimate weapons was inadequate, but because the ultimate methods inside the Clan Suppression Weapons were not activated.

But if Lin Yuan wanted to completely kill these strongest Level Eleven entities, the ultimate methods inside the Clan Suppression Weapons would definitely be activated.

After all, since the various peak clans have allowed the Clan Suppression Weapons to enter the battlefield, they must be fully prepared and won’t allow them to be lost easily.

“First concentrate all the forces to see if we can kill one.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, and his eyes focused on the strongest Level Eleven of the Insect Race—

Boom!!

An invisible shock enveloped the strongest Level Eleven of the Insect Race, and the Nightmare Realm weapon she held could not help trembling.

“Not good!!”

The scalp of the strongest Level Eleven of the Insect Race burst open, and she suddenly realized that the Galaxy Master, without her knowing when, had already appeared close to her, extending his right hand and slowly pressing down towards her.
